verdict.rationale: Gmail ships a first-party RESTful API that covers core mailbox operations. It can send messages and drafts, manage threads, messages and labels, configure filters and signatures, and push mailbox-change notifications, so much of the UI is reachable programmatically. However, the pack shows no API equivalents for several UI features, including snooze, undo send, and the Gemini summarize, draft and organize tools, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of API parity for snooze, undo send and Gemini AI features; any documented parity statement; independent confirmation of UI-to-API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Sends the specified message to the recipients in the `To`, `Cc`, and `Bcc` headers.
You can send it from a draft, using the drafts.send method.
When a message matches, filters automatically trigger actions such as adding or removing labels, or forwarding the email to a specified address.
The Gmail API provides server push notifications that let you watch for changes to Gmail mailboxes.
